description: The default weights with the paraphrase evidence rule written out (the default of every scoring file since 2026-11-20): a judge's evidence counts when the lenient rule finds it, or when it restates the output faithfully (every figure of two or more digits it names is in the output, and most of its content words are). A fabricated or absent point still fails. The view is rebuilt from the saved outputs; a record with no workspace takes its recorded lenient view.
